description: aiter's MLA decode of several causal queries a request on one rank of decode context parallelism over a round-robin KV shard (aiter.mla.mla_decode_fwd with g_kv_indptr, cp_world_size and cp_rank, as vLLM verifies draft tokens): request b reads pool rows kv_indices[kv_indptr[b]:kv_indptr[b + 1]], its local row j holding global position j * cp_world_size + cp_rank; of G = g_kv_indptr[b + 1] - g_kv_indptr[b] global tokens, its query i sits at global position G - query_length + i and reads the local rows at or before it. Logits are q . row * q_scale * kv_scale * sm_scale over the 576 values, the rope part last, and values row[:512] * kv_scale. A query reading no row: o 0, lse -inf.

query_length.description: Queries a request: the last token and its drafts.

n_heads.description: Query heads: every rank's, gathered, as the caller pads them.

n_indices.description: Entries of kv_indices; the first kv_indptr[batch] are read.

n_offsets.description: Entries of kv_indptr and g_kv_indptr: batch + 1.

q.description: Each request's queries: the absorbed no-rope part, then the rope part.

kv_buffer.description: The KV pool: a 576-value row a slot, the rope part last.

kv_indptr.description: Where each request's shard on this rank starts in kv_indices, then where the last ends; a shard may run past the global length, its later rows read by no query.

kv_indices.description: Pool rows, each request's shard back to back in global order.

g_kv_indptr.description: Cumulative global token counts of the requests, the queries' tokens included.

kv_scale.description: Multiplies every KV value, in the logits and the values.

cp_rank.description: This rank in the decode context parallel group.

o.description: Softmax-weighted sum of the read values.

lse.description: Natural log-sum-exp of the scaled logits a query reads.

sources.content:
"""FlyDSL MLA verify on a round-robin DCP shard over a pool of fp8 rows: each request's QL x HQ (query, head) pairs
packed flat into rows of NHEAD heads, one CTA per chunk of a row's keys, its logit and value waves a step apart over
an LDS ring of raw fp8 key tiles filled by async DMAs; a row's f16 partials merge in chunk order into bf16."""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir as _ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _arith
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _mrocdl
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import scf as _scf
from flydsl.compiler import from_c_void_p
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
from flydsl.expr.typing import BFloat16, Float8E4M3FN, Float16, Float32, Int32, Int64, T
from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec

NHEAD = 64  # (query, head) pairs a row: two logit waves, a query's heads in two rows, no padding heads
DQK = 576
DV = 512
BI = 32
TILE8 = DQK * BI  # bytes of a raw fp8 key tile, piece-major: (key k, 16-byte piece c) at (c BI + k) 16
PIECE = BI * 16  # bytes of one 16-byte piece of every key of a tile
NQK = DQK // 64  # logit MFMAs a step, 64 dims each (32 keys by 32 heads)
NR = 4  # key tiles in the LDS ring
DMAD = NR - 2  # steps a tile's async DMA is issued ahead of its use
VTW = NR * TILE8 // 4  # LDS words of the key ring
NQT = NHEAD // 16
# Waves below NQW run the logits and softmax of TPW 16-head tiles; the others run the value GEMM a step behind.
TPW = 2
NQW = NQT // TPW
NWT = 8
THREADS = NWT * 64
# 16-dim value tiles of value waves NQW .. (on SIMDs 2, 3, 0, 1, 2, 3), even for the paired store: the waves beside
# the logit waves take few to keep those SIMDs short, and a polling last wave takes fewer than its SIMD partner.
VTILES = (6, 6, 2, 2, 8, 8)
VTILES_LASTPOLL = (8, 8, 2, 2, 6, 6)
assert sum(VTILES) == DV // 16 and sum(VTILES_LASTPOLL) == DV // 16
assert all(v % 2 == 0 for v in VTILES + VTILES_LASTPOLL)
PWORDS = 64 * 4  # Int32 words of one head tile's f16 P
# Value waves NQW + GV0 .. NQW + GV1, the 2-tile ones beside the logit waves, DMA every key tile into LDS.
GV0 = 2  # first gathering value wave
GV1 = 3  # last gathering value wave
NGW = GV1 + 1 - GV0  # gathering waves
PPW = DQK // 32 // NGW  # piece pairs (one DMA each) a gathering wave fetches a step
NSR = 4  # slot-index ring entries of a gathering wave (one step's 32 table entries, twice)
assert NSR > NR - 2
assert PPW * NGW * 32 == DQK
CPT = DV // 64
CUNR = 4  # combine: partial loads in flight a lane
CSL = 4  # combine: column slices of a head, one wave each, and chunk groups of a wave
MINSTEPS = 8  # fewest steps a chunk
LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
LN2 = 0.6931471805599453
NEGBIG = -1.0e30
MINIT = -1.0e20
TAU = 29.0  # rescale threshold (log2 units): the max a step may gain before the reference moves
ROFF = TAU - 15.0  # weights against max + ROFF: the max's 2^-ROFF a normal f16, P < 2^(TAU - ROFF) finite
VLA = 3  # value-GEMM raw tile reads in flight ahead of their MFMAs
QLA = 2  # logit-GEMM tile reads in flight ahead of their MFMA
SC1 = 16  # cache-policy bit of a write-through store: the kernel's end has no dirty lines of it to flush
SC1ROWS = 32  # the partials are stored write-through up to this many rows, write-back (the default) above
ROWRED = (0xB1, 0x4E, 0x141, 0x140)  # DPP xor 1, xor 2, row mirror, row half mirror
ROWSHR = 0x110  # DPP row_shr:0
ROWROR8 = 0x128  # DPP row_ror:8
QL = 8  # queries a request
HQ = 128  # heads a query
CPW = 8  # decode context-parallel world size
RPQ = (QL * HQ + NHEAD - 1) // NHEAD  # rows a request: its (query, head) pairs packed flat, NHEAD a row
NXCD = 8  # XCDs, which take the CTAs round-robin
FLP = 32  # int32 words a row's arrival word line: each word on its own cache line
WAIT_TICKS = 2000  # s_memrealtime ticks a chunk waits for its row before handing off its slice
TAG_H1 = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 - (1 << 64)  # odd multipliers of the launch tag (signed i64)
TAG_H2 = 0x632BE59BD9B4E019
CNTB = 12  # bits of the arrival count (lowest) and of the hand-off count (next) of a word's low half
CNTM = (1 << CNTB) - 1
TAGM = -(1 << (2 * CNTB))  # the tag's bits of an arrival word's low half
ROLE_SCAN = 1  # merge role: completed the arrivals after hand-offs, merges its slice and the handed-off ones
ROLE_OWN = 2  # merges its own slice
ROLE_GAVE = 3  # handed its slice off
ROLE_LAST = 4  # completed the arrivals with no hand-off
MCH = 32  # merge: chunk weights of a head in a wave's merge block, one a lane
NU = NHEAD * DV // 8  # 16-byte units of a row's partial
KAPRE = 16  # kernel argument words preloaded into SGPRs, sparing the prologue their s_load


def _bstore(vec, rsrc, byte_off, aux):
    """Buffer store of a value at a byte offset with the given cache-policy bits."""
    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
        vec if isinstance(vec, _ir.Value) else vec.ir_value(),
        rsrc,
        fx.Int32(byte_off).ir_value(),
        fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
        aux=_ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, aux),
    )


def _if_else(cond, then_fn, else_fn, types):
    """scf.if with both branches computing values (ir values or FlyDSL values) of the given types."""
    op = _scf.IfOp(cond if isinstance(cond, _ir.Value) else cond.ir_value(), types, has_else=True)
    with _ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        _scf.YieldOp([x if isinstance(x, _ir.Value) else x.ir_value() for x in then_fn()])
    if len(op.regions[1].blocks) == 0:
        op.regions[1].blocks.append(*[])
    with _ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        _scf.YieldOp([x if isinstance(x, _ir.Value) else x.ir_value() for x in else_fn()])
    return list(op.results)


def _tree_max(xs):
    """The maximum of a list as a balanced tree (exact, so its order does not matter): log2 dependent steps."""
    while len(xs) > 1:
        xs = [xs[i].maximumf(xs[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(xs) - 1, 2)] + xs[len(xs) - len(xs) % 2 :]
    return xs[0]


def _keep_branch():
    """An empty side-effecting asm: keeps LLVM from if-converting the enclosing branch into selects."""
    _llvm.inline_asm(None, [], "", "", has_side_effects=True)


def _spec_plan(rows, width, nblk, rank, n_indices):
    """The chunks a row _plan gives every row when each request holds n_indices / batch rows and G = (rows - 1) CPW
    + 1 global tokens, or None where that split is uneven or the rows' chunk counts differ. Only a guess, from the
    shape: the kernel checks the row it places a CTA on against the real plan's."""
    nreq = rows // RPQ
    NGRP = (rows + 63) // 64
    if NGRP != 1 or nblk % NXCD or n_indices % nreq or n_indices <= 0:
        return None
    ln = n_indices // nreq
    g = (ln - 1) * CPW + 1

    def seen(i):
        pos = g - (QL + rank) + i
        return 0 if pos < 0 else min(pos // CPW + 1, ln)

    sts = []
    for r in range(rows):
        k = r % RPQ
        lc = min(max(seen(min((k * NHEAD + NHEAD - 1) // HQ, QL - 1)), 0), width)
        sts.append((lc + BI - 1) // BI)
    tot = sum(sts)

    def nch(s):
        return sum(max(1, (st + s - 1) // s) for st in sts)

    tmax = rows * ((width + BI - 1) // BI)
    span = 2 + tmax * rows // (nblk * (nblk - rows))
    nbis = 1
    while (1 << nbis) <= span:
        nbis += 1
    lo = max((tot + nblk - 1) // nblk, MINSTEPS)
    hi = max((tot + nblk - rows - 1) // (nblk - rows), MINSTEPS)
    nr = sum(1 for k in range(nbis) if hi - lo >= (1 << k))
    for _ in range(nr):
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if nch(mid) <= nblk:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    stp = hi
    cs = {max(1, (st + stp - 1) // stp) for st in sts}
    if len(cs) != 1:
        return None
    return cs.pop()


@functools.cache
def _build(sm_scale, rows, width, dev, rank, n_indices):
    """Compile the partial and combine kernels for one row count and table width: a power of two at least
    kv_indices' entries."""
    ncu = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(dev).multi_processor_count
    nblk = ncu
    NGRP = (rows + 63) // 64
    SPEC = _spec_plan(rows, width, nblk, rank, n_indices)
    tau = float(TAU - ROFF)  # a closure float: the rescale threshold is part of the kernel's cache key
    roff = float(ROFF)
    FOLD = rows <= SC1ROWS  # the chunks of a row merge it themselves after a bounded rendezvous
    PSTORE = SC1 if FOLD else 0
    ABOFF = rows * FLP  # int32 word of the per-slot hand-off words
    CB = min(MCH, -(-nblk // rows))  # merge: chunks a lane weighs per load batch
    # The wave that polls a row's arrival word: the last where a chunk's merge slice spans every wave, else wave 0.
    POLLW = NWT - 1 if NU // CB > THREADS // 2 else 0
    vtiles = VTILES_LASTPOLL if POLLW == NWT - 1 else VTILES
    CB4 = (CB + 3) // 4  # 4-weight LDS reads of a head's chunk weights
    MWB = 4 * MCH + 4  # LDS words of a wave's merge block: two heads' masked LSEs and weights, their maxima
    assert NWT * MWB <= 2 * NWT * PWORDS

    @fx.struct
    class Shared:
        """LDS: the key tile ring; P and the rescale factors (two parities each); 1 / sum per head; slot rings."""

        vt: fx.Array[Int32, VTW, 16]
        pb: fx.Array[Int32, 2 * NWT * PWORDS, 16]
        ab: fx.Array[Float32, 2 * NWT * 16, 16]
        ib: fx.Array[Float32, NHEAD, 16]
        sl: fx.Array[Int32, NGW * NSR * 64, 16]

    tmax = rows * ((width + BI - 1) // BI)
    # S = ceil(steps / (grid - rows)) always fits; hi - lo <= tot rows / (nblk (nblk - rows)) + 1 for any
    # tot <= tmax, so the bisection covers just that range.
    span = 2 + tmax * rows // (nblk * (nblk - rows))
    NBIS = 1
    while (1 << NBIS) <= span:
        NBIS += 1
    NSLOT = nblk  # chunk b's partial is slot b

    smul = float(sm_scale) * LOG2E

    def _dpp(x, ctrl):
        """Lane value of x under DPP control ctrl (every lane's source valid, else 0)."""
        xi = fx.Int32(x).ir_value()
        z = fx.Int32(0).ir_value()
        return fx.Int32(rocdl.update_dpp(T.i32, z, xi, ctrl, 0xF, 0xF, True))

    def _iswap(x, wide):
        """Lane value of x plus that of lane ^ 16 (wide: ^ 32), by one permlane swap."""
        xi = fx.Int32(x).ir_value()
        op = rocdl.permlane32_swap if wide else rocdl.permlane16_swap
        st = op(_llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]), xi, xi, False, False)
        return fx.Int32(_llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, st, [0])) + fx.Int32(_llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, st, [1]))

    def _wsum(x):
        """Sum of the Int32 x over the 64 lanes of the wave, as a scalar: DPP quad xors and row mirrors reduce each
        16-lane row, two permlane swaps the rows."""
        for ctrl in ROWRED:
            x = x + _dpp(x, ctrl)
        x = _iswap(x, False)
        x = _iswap(x, True)
        return _uni(x)

    def _uni(x):
        """A wave-uniform Int32 moved to a scalar register."""
        return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, x))

    def _lane(x, l):
        """x of lane l (a scalar) as a scalar."""
        return fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(x).ir_value(), fx.Int32(l).ir_value()))

    def _first_lane(mask):
        """The lowest lane set in a ballot mask, as a scalar."""
        lo = _arith.trunci(T.i32, _llvm.intr_cttz(mask, False, results=[T.i64]))
        return _uni(fx.Int32(lo) & fx.Int32(63))

    def _xscan(x, lane):
        """Exclusive prefix sum of the Int32 x over the wave's lanes, and the wave total as a scalar: DPP row scans,
        then the row totals read out of lanes 15, 31, 47, 63."""
        lr16 = lane % 16
        pre = x
        for sh in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            rem = _dpp(pre, ROWSHR + sh)
            pre = (lr16 >= fx.Int32(sh)).select(pre + rem, pre)
        rt = [_lane(pre, 16 * k + 15) for k in range(4)]
        pre = (
            pre
            + (lane >= fx.Int32(16)).select(rt[0], fx.Int32(0))
            + (lane >= fx.Int32(32)).select(rt[1], fx.Int32(0))
            + (lane >= fx.Int32(48)).select(rt[2], fx.Int32(0))
        )
        return pre - x, rt[0] + rt[1] + rt[2] + rt[3]

    def _req(kvp, gp, req):
        """Request req's first table entry, local row count and global token count."""
        rt = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(kvp, req)))
        ln = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(kvp, req + fx.Int32(1)))) - rt
        g = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(gp, req + fx.Int32(1)))) - fx.Int32(
            fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(gp, req))
        )
        return rt, ln, g

    def _seen(g, ln, i):
        """Local rows query i (an Int32) of a request of g global tokens and ln local rows reads."""
        pos = g - fx.Int32(QL + rank) + i
        s = pos // CPW + fx.Int32(1)
        s = (pos < fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(0), s)
        return (s > ln).select(ln, s)

    def _qof(fh):
        """The query of flat head fh (an Int32) of a request, the padding heads past the last query's taken as it."""
        i = fh // HQ
        return (i > fx.Int32(QL - 1)).select(fx.Int32(QL - 1), i)

    def _plan(kvp, gp, lane, after_loads=None):
        """Each wave's own chunking (lane l holds rows l + 64 g): chunks of S steps, S the smallest whose chunk count
        fits the grid. Returns the per-row state, the bisection's bounds on S, its round count and what after_loads
        returns, run while the row loads fly; the kernel runs the rounds with _fits and places its chunk with _place."""
        lcs = []
        sts = []
        oks = []
        rts = []
        rls = []
        rgs = []
        tot = fx.Int32(0)
        loaded = []
        for g in range_constexpr(NGRP):
            r = lane + fx.Int32(64 * g)
            ok = r < fx.Int32(rows)
            rs = ok.select(r, fx.Int32(0))
            req = rs // RPQ
            k = rs - req * RPQ
            loaded.append((ok, k, _req(kvp, gp, req)))
        extra = None
        if const_expr(after_loads is not None):
            extra = after_loads()
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        for g in range_constexpr(NGRP):
            ok, k, (rt, rl, rg) = loaded[g]
            rls.append(rl)
            rgs.append(rg)
            # the row reads the prefix its last head's query reads; its earlier queries mask the rest per tile
            ln = _seen(rg, rl, _qof(k * NHEAD + fx.Int32(NHEAD - 1)))
            lc = (ln > fx.Int32(width)).select(fx.Int32(width), ln)
            lc = (lc < fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(0), lc)
            lc = ok.select(lc, fx.Int32(0))
            st = (lc + fx.Int32(BI - 1)) // BI
            lcs.append(lc)
            sts.append(st)
            oks.append(ok)
            rts.append(rt)
            tot = tot + st
        tot = _wsum(tot)

        def chunks(s):
            cs = []
            for g in range_constexpr(NGRP):
                c = (sts[g] + s - fx.Int32(1)) // s
                c = (c < fx.Int32(1)).select(fx.Int32(1), c)
                cs.append(oks[g].select(c, fx.Int32(0)))
            return cs

        lo = (tot + fx.Int32(nblk - 1)) // nblk
        lo = (lo < fx.Int32(MINSTEPS)).select(fx.Int32(MINSTEPS), lo)
        hi = (tot + fx.Int32(nblk - rows - 1)) // (nblk - rows)
        hi = (hi < fx.Int32(MINSTEPS)).select(fx.Int32(MINSTEPS), hi)
        # Bisection rounds: floor(log2(hi - lo)) + 1 halvings take [lo, hi] to one candidate.
        dlh = hi - lo
        nr = fx.Int32(0)
        for k in range_constexpr(NBIS):
            nr = nr + (dlh >= fx.Int32(1 << k)).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
        return (lcs, oks, rts, chunks, rls, rgs), lo, hi, nr, extra

    def _fits(pl, s):
        """Whether chunks of s steps fit the grid."""
        cs = pl[3](s)
        n = cs[0]
        for g in range_constexpr(1, NGRP):
            n = n + cs[g]
        return _wsum(n) <= fx.Int32(nblk)

    def _place(pl, stp, b, lane):
        """Chunk b's row, the row's first chunk, its chunk count and live length, the chunk length in keys, the
        chunk count and the row's first table entry, for chunks of stp steps."""
        lcs, _, rts, chunks, _, _ = pl
        cs = chunks(stp)
        # Chunk counts prefixed in row order, lane-major within each group of 64 rows.
        base = fx.Int32(0)
        row = fx.Int32(0)
        cbase = fx.Int32(0)
        crow = fx.Int32(0)
        lrow = fx.Int32(0)
        rowt = fx.Int32(0)
        anyh = fx.Int32(0)
        for g in range_constexpr(NGRP):
            ex, gt = _xscan(cs[g], lane)
            ex = base + ex
            hit = (b >= ex).select((b < ex + cs[g]).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)), fx.Int32(0))
            hb = hit != fx.Int32(0)
            row = row + hb.select(lane + fx.Int32(64 * g), fx.Int32(0))
            cbase = cbase + hb.select(ex, fx.Int32(0))
            crow = crow + hb.select(cs[g], fx.Int32(0))
            lrow = lrow + hb.select(lcs[g], fx.Int32(0))
            rowt = rowt + hb.select(rts[g], fx.Int32(0))
            anyh = anyh + hit
            base = base + gt
        # At most one lane of one group holds chunk b: read its values out of that lane.
        hl = _first_lane(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, anyh != fx.Int32(0)))
        row = _lane(row, hl)
        cbase = _lane(cbase, hl)
        crow = _lane(crow, hl)
        lrow = _lane(lrow, hl)
        rowt = _lane(rowt, hl)
        cnum = _uni(base)
        return row, cbase, crow, lrow, stp * BI, cnum, rowt

    def _keymajor(pl, stp, bx, lane):
        """The chunk CTA bx runs: the CTAs of one XCD take a request's chunks key range first, row second, so the
        rows reading a key range share that XCD's L2. Taken only when each request's rows have one chunk count,
        else chunk bx."""
        cs = pl[3](stp)[0]
        o = (bx % fx.Int32(NXCD)) * fx.Int32(nblk // NXCD) + bx // fx.Int32(NXCD)
        nq = rows // RPQ
        cq = [_lane(cs, q * RPQ) for q in range(nq)]
        exp_ = cq[0]
        for q in range_constexpr(1, nq):
            exp_ = (lane >= fx.Int32(q * RPQ)).select(cq[q], exp_)
        bad = (lane < fx.Int32(rows)) & (cs != exp_)
        uniform = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, bad)) == fx.Int64(0)
        nb = o
        base = fx.Int32(0)
        for q in range_constexpr(nq):
            n_q = cq[q] * fx.Int32(RPQ)
            d = o - base
            inq = (o >= base) & (d < n_q)
            nb = inq.select(base + (d % fx.Int32(RPQ)) * cq[q] + d // fx.Int32(RPQ), nb)
            base = base + n_q
        return _uni(uniform.select(nb, bx))

    def _swap(x, wide):
        """The pair (x, x of lane ^ 16) (wide: ^ 32) in some order, in every lane, by one permlane swap."""
        xi = fx.Float32(x).bitcast(Int32).ir_value()
        op = rocdl.permlane32_swap if wide else rocdl.permlane16_swap
        st = op(_llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]), xi, xi, False, False)
        return [fx.Int32(_llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, st, [k])).bitcast(Float32) for k in range(2)]

    @flyc.kernel
    def part_kernel(ks_t, qs_t, ln_t, gp_t, q_t, bt_t, kv_t, fl_t, po_t, pl_t, out_t, lse_t, mt_t):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        b = fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.x)
        # The logit scale (log2 units) and the value scale, read from the device scalars.
        vscale = fx.Float32(fx.ptr_load(ks_t))
        scale2 = fx.Float32(fx.ptr_load(qs_t)) * vscale * fx.Float32(smul)
        inv_s2 = fx.Float32(1.0) / scale2

        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
        vi = fx.recast_iter(Int32, lds.vt.ptr)
        vb8 = fx.recast_iter(Float8E4M3FN, lds.vt.ptr)
        pbp = lds.pb.ptr
        abp = lds.ab.ptr
        ibp = lds.ib.ptr

        lane = tid % 64
        wave = tid // 64
        uw = _uni(wave)
        lr = lane % 16
        lg = lane // 16

        def q_at(row_):
            """A logit wave's Q of the given row: lane l loads head l % 32 of the wave, dims 32 (l // 32) .. +32 of
            each 64."""
            rq_ = row_ // RPQ
            f_ = (row_ - rq_ * RPQ) * NHEAD + uw * 32 + lane % 32
            f_ = (f_ > fx.Int32(QL * HQ - 1)).select(fx.Int32(QL * HQ - 1), f_)
            qb_ = (rq_ * (QL * HQ) + f_) * (DQK // 4)
            out_ = []
            for m in range_constexpr(NQK):
                qo = qb_ + 16 * m + (lane // 32) * 8
                out_.append(Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(q_t, qo), T.i32x4)))
                out_.append(Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(q_t, qo + 4), T.i32x4)))
            return out_

        def spec_loads():
            """The logit waves' Q at the row the guessed plan gives this CTA, loaded while the real plan waits on
            kv_indptr; used only where the real plan places the CTA on that row."""
            c_g = SPEC
            o_g = (b % fx.Int32(NXCD)) * fx.Int32(nblk // NXCD) + b // fx.Int32(NXCD)
            q_g = o_g // fx.Int32(c_g * RPQ)
            d_g = o_g - q_g * fx.Int32(c_g * RPQ)
            nb_g = (q_g < fx.Int32(rows // RPQ)).select(
                q_g * fx.Int32(c_g * RPQ) + (d_g % fx.Int32(RPQ)) * fx.Int32(c_g) + d_g // fx.Int32(RPQ), o_g
            )
            row_g = nb_g // fx.Int32(c_g)
            row_g = (row_g > fx.Int32(rows - 1)).select(fx.Int32(rows - 1), row_g)

            def q_spec():
                _keep_branch()
                return q_at(row_g)

            spec_q = _if_else(
                uw < fx.Int32(NQW),
                q_spec,
                lambda: [Vec.filled(4, 0, Int32)] * (2 * NQK),
                [T.i32x4] * (2 * NQK),
            )
            return row_g, spec_q

        # The row-aligned split: the fewest steps S whose chunks of S steps, each in one row, fit the grid.
        pl, blo, bhi, nr, spec = _plan(ln_t, gp_t, lane, spec_loads if SPEC is not None else None)
        if const_expr(SPEC is not None):
            spec_row, spec_q = spec
        for _, bs in range(fx.Int32(0), nr, fx.Int32(1), init=[blo, bhi]):
            lo_ = fx.Int32(bs[0])
            hi_ = fx.Int32(bs[1])
            mid = (lo_ + hi_) // 2
            fit = _fits(pl, mid)
            bres = yield [fit.select(lo_, mid + fx.Int32(1)), fit.select(mid, hi_)]
        S = fx.Int32(bres[1])
        if const_expr(NGRP == 1 and nblk % NXCD == 0):
            b = _keymajor(pl, S, b, lane)
        orow, ocbase, ocrow, oln, och, ocnum, orowt = _place(pl, S, b, lane)

        def aligned_seg():
            """This CTA's chunk: (row, the row's first chunk, its chunk count, place in the row, partial slot, key start,
            key end, steps, the row's first table entry)."""
            osp = b - ocbase
            op0 = osp * och
            oen = op0 + och
            oen = (oen > oln).select(oln, oen)
            osn = oen - op0
            osn = (osn < fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(0), osn)
            osteps = (osn + fx.Int32(BI - 1)) // BI
            return orow, ocbase, ocrow, osp, b, op0, oen, osteps, orowt

        def seg_body():
            """The chunk's partial, or for a row's only chunk its output."""
            row, cbase, crow, sp, slot, pos0, end, nsteps, rowt = aligned_seg()
            rreq = row // RPQ
            fh0 = (row - rreq * RPQ) * NHEAD  # the row's first flat (query, head) pair of its request
            obase = rreq * (QL * HQ) + fh0
            if const_expr(not FOLD):
                if tid + sp == fx.Int32(0):
                    fx.ptr_store(
                        Vec.from_elements([cbase, crow], Int32),
                        fx.add_offset(mt_t, row * 2),
                    )

            # The pool comes as a raw pointer: it may span more than 2^31 words, past what a tensor argument's
            # 32-bit shape or a 32-bit element offset reaches, so a row's address is formed in 64 bits.
            kvbase = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(kv_t))
            kvrow = fx.PointerType.get(fx.Int32.ir_type, address_space=fx.AddressSpace.Global, alignment=16)

            def kv_row(sidx):
                """Pool row sidx (an Int32 table entry, sign-extended as an element offset would be)."""
                wide = fx.Int64(_arith.ExtSIOp(T.i64, fx.Int32(sidx).ir_value()).result)
                return fx.inttoptr(kvrow, kvbase + wide * DQK)

            kk = tid % BI
            # V read (ds_read_b64_tr_b8): lane 2j + h of group lg points at half h of key 4 lg + j % 4 + 16 (j // 4),
            # so lane l gets dim l % 16 of keys 4 lg + e, 16 + 4 lg + e: the P layout of the logit waves.
            jl = (lane % 16) // 2
            trb8 = (lg * 4 + jl % 4 + (jl // 4) * 16) * 16 + (lane % 2) * 8
            one_f = fx.Float32(1.0).ir_value()

            lastk = end - fx.Int32(1)
            lastk = (lastk < fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(0), lastk)

            def table_pos(spos):
                """Where the table entry of the key at spos is read: past the chunk's end, its last key's (its logit
                is masked); for a request reading no row entry 0, which exists, where the row's own start may lie past
                the table's end."""
                return (end > fx.Int32(0)).select(rowt + (spos < end).select(spos, lastk), fx.Int32(0))

            def slot_at(spos):
                """Table entry of the key at spos, or of the chunk's last key past its end (its logit is masked)."""
                return fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(bt_t, table_pos(spos)))

            # PV(-1) of the first step must add exactly zero: tile NR - 1's value blocks, P and alpha parity 1.
            zi4 = Vec.filled(4, 0, Int32)
            for z in range_constexpr(DV * BI // 16 // THREADS):
                fx.ptr_store(zi4, fx.add_offset(vi, (NR - 1) * TILE8 // 4 + (tid + THREADS * z) * 4))
            fx.ptr_store(zi4, fx.add_offset(pbp, NWT * PWORDS + tid * 4))
            if tid < fx.Int32(NWT * 16):
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec.from_elements([fx.Float32(1.0)], Float32),
                    fx.add_offset(abp, NWT * 16 + tid),
                )
            tr_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(rocdl.cdna4.LDSReadTrans8_64b(), Float8E4M3FN)
            tr_layout = fx.make_layout(8, 1)

            def pv_offsets(n0, ndv):
                """Per-lane LDS byte offsets of value tiles n0 .. n0 + ndv - 1 (n0 wave-uniform): piece n."""
                return [trb8 + (n0 + fx.Int32(d)) * PIECE for d in range(ndv)]

            def pv_raw(off, base):
                """The raw fp8 A operand of a value tile: 8 fp8 values by one transposed read."""
                src = fx.make_view(fx.add_offset(vb8, off + base), tr_layout)
                dst = fx.make_rmem_tensor(tr_layout, Float8E4M3FN)
                fx.copy(tr_atom, src, dst)
                return Vec(dst.load()).bitcast(Int32)

            def pv_cvt(v, k):
                """f16 pair k (0..3) of a raw value tile, converted exactly."""
                w = fx.Int32(v[k // 2]).ir_value()
                pk = Vec(rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_f16_fp8(T.vec(2, T.f16), w, one_f, k % 2 == 1))
                return fx.Int32(pk.bitcast(Int32)[0])

            def pv_step(acc, offs, base, ppar):
                """acc[ndv h + d] = alpha_h acc[ndv h + d] + V_d P_h for the previous step (tile at base, parity
                ppar). Value-tile major: tile d + 1's conversion and tile d + VLA's read issue between tile d's
                MFMAs."""
                ndv = len(offs)
                acc = list(acc)
                # Reads in the order the first MFMAs need them: value tile 0, alpha, P, then the other VLA - 1 tiles.
                raw = [pv_raw(offs[0], base)]
                ahs = [
                    fx.Float32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(abp, ppar * (NWT * 16) + 16 * h + lr)))
                    for h in range(NQT)
                ]
                phs = [
                    Vec(
                        fx.ptr_load(
                            fx.add_offset(pbp, ppar * (NWT * PWORDS) + h * PWORDS + lane * 4),
                            T.i32x4,
                        )
                    ).bitcast(Float16)
                    for h in range(NQT)
                ]
                raw += [pv_raw(offs[d], base) for d in range(1, min(VLA, ndv))]
                for h in range_constexpr(NQT):
                    ah = ahs[h]
                    aa = [acc[ndv * h + d] for d in range(ndv)]
                    rescale = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, ah != fx.Float32(1.0)))
                    if rescale != fx.Int64(0):  # wave-uniform: most steps rescale no head of a tile
                        _keep_branch()
                        a4 = Vec.from_elements([ah] * 4, Float32)
                        aa = [Vec(x * a4) for x in aa]
                    for d in range_constexpr(ndv):
                        acc[ndv * h + d] = aa[d]
                cur = [pv_cvt(raw[0], k) for k in range(4)]
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                rocdl.s_setprio(1)  # the value MFMAs go ahead of the logit wave's on the same SIMD
                for d in range_constexpr(ndv):
                    vb = Vec.from_elements(cur, Int32).bitcast(Float16)
                    if d + VLA < ndv:
                        raw.append(pv_raw(offs[d + VLA], base))
                    nxt = []
                    for h in range_constexpr(NQT):
                        acc[ndv * h + d] = Vec(
                            rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_f16(T.f32x4, [vb, phs[h], acc[ndv * h + d]])
                        )
                        if d + 1 < ndv and h < 4:
                            nxt.append(pv_cvt(raw[d + 1], h))
                        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                    cur = nxt
                rocdl.s_setprio(0)
                return acc

            nm1 = (nsteps > fx.Int32(0)).select(nsteps - fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))

            def pv_only(acc, poffs, itv):
                """Step itv of a value wave without DMAs: PV(itv - 1) only."""
                fx.barrier()
                return pv_step(
                    acc,
                    poffs,
                    ((itv + fx.Int32(NR - 1)) % fx.Int32(NR)) * TILE8,
                    fx.Int32(1) - (itv & fx.Int32(1)),
                )

            def store_direct(acc, n0, ndv, out):
                """Store the normalized partial from the accumulators (head 16h + lr, dims 16 (n0 + d) + 4lg .. +4): a
                permlane16 swap of tiles d, d + 1 gives lane (lg, lr) a 16-byte unit, dims 8 (lg // 2) .. +8 of tile
                d + lg % 2. out: a row's only chunk's bf16 output, else an f16 partial (the combine rounds to bf16)."""
                if const_expr(out):
                    nrec = (rows // RPQ) * QL * HQ * DV * 2
                    rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(out_t, num_records_bytes=nrec))
                    ebase = obase * DV
                    aux = 0
                else:
                    nrec = NSLOT * NHEAD * DV * 2
                    rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(po_t, num_records_bytes=nrec))
                    ebase = slot * (NHEAD * DV)
                    aux = PSTORE
                st2 = _llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32])
                for h in range_constexpr(NQT):
                    ivh = fx.Float32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(ibp, 16 * h + lr)))
                    hrow = fx.Int32(16 * h) + lr
                    live = fh0 + hrow < fx.Int32(QL * HQ)  # padding heads are never read
                    wvs = []
                    for d in range_constexpr(ndv):
                        vals = Vec.from_elements(
                            [fx.Float32(acc[ndv * h + d][e]) * ivh for e in range(4)],
                            Float32,
                        )
                        wvs.append(vals.to(BFloat16 if out else Float16).bitcast(Int32))
                    for d in range_constexpr(0, ndv, 2):
                        lo_ = []
                        hi_ = []
                        for k in range_constexpr(2):
                            sw = rocdl.permlane16_swap(
                                st2,
                                fx.Int32(wvs[d][k]).ir_value(),
                                fx.Int32(wvs[d + 1][k]).ir_value(),
                                False,
                                False,
                            )
                            lo_.append(fx.Int32(_llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, sw, [0])))
                            hi_.append(fx.Int32(_llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, sw, [1])))
                        v4 = Vec.from_elements(lo_ + hi_, Int32)
                        dim = (n0 + fx.Int32(d) + lg % 2) * 16 + (lg // 2) * 8
                        off = live.select((ebase + hrow * DV + dim) * 2, fx.Int32(nrec))
                        _bstore(v4, rs, off, aux)

            def store_out(acc, n0, ndv):
                if crow == fx.Int32(1):
                    _keep_branch()
                    store_direct(acc, n0, ndv, True)
                if crow != fx.Int32(1):
                    _keep_branch()
                    store_direct(acc, n0, ndv, False)

            if uw < fx.Int32(NQW):
                # Lane l holds head l % 32 of the wave and key l % 32 of the tile, the same dims in both operands so
                # the fp8 k order cancels; NHEAD and HQ are multiples of the wave's heads, which are one query's.
                hl = lane % 32
                hc = lane // 32
                if const_expr(SPEC is not None):

                    def q_real():
                        _keep_branch()
                        return q_at(row)

                    qh = _if_else(row == spec_row, lambda: spec_q, q_real, [T.i32x4] * (2 * NQK))
                else:
                    qh = q_at(row)
                qv = [
                    Vec(qh[2 * m]).shuffle(Vec(qh[2 * m + 1]), [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) for m in range(NQK)
                ]
                # The Q loads land before the loop, so the waitcnt pass emits no vmcnt waits inside it.
                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
                ridx = rreq * RPQ
                sl_ = fx.Int32(0)
                sg_ = fx.Int32(0)
                for g in range_constexpr(NGRP):
                    ing = (ridx // 64) == fx.Int32(g)
                    sl_ = ing.select(_lane(pl[4][g], ridx % 64), sl_)
                    sg_ = ing.select(_lane(pl[5][g], ridx % 64), sg_)
                e = _seen(sg_, sl_, _qof(fh0 + uw * 32))
                et = _uni((e > end).select(end, e))  # the wave's query reads the keys before et
                unit = fx.Int32(0x7F7F7F7F)  # E8M0 scale 1.0
                qkb = hl * 16 + hc * (2 * PIECE)

                def kread(tb, m):
                    """K read m: key hl of the tile at byte tb, dims 64 m + 32 hc .. +32, pieces 4 m + 2 hc and the
                    next."""
                    kb = qkb + tb + (4 * PIECE) * m
                    h0 = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(vi, kb // 4), T.i32x4))
                    h1 = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(vi, (kb + PIECE) // 4), T.i32x4))
                    return h0.shuffle(h1, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])

                tq = uw * TPW + hl // 16
                pslot0 = tq * PWORDS + (hc * 16 + lr) * 4
                pslot1 = tq * PWORDS + ((hc + 2) * 16 + lr) * 4
                ones2 = Vec.filled(2, 1.0, Float16).ir_value()
                init = [
                    fx.Float32(MINIT),
                    fx.Float32(0.0),
                    Vec.filled(8, 0.0, Float16),
                    Vec.filled(8, 0.0, Float16),
                ]

                def rowsum(srs_, pa_, pb_):
                    """srs_ plus the sum of a step's f16 weights, run in the next step's K-read window: v_dot2_f32_f16
                    against ones adds each f16 pair exactly into one f32 rounding, so o's numerator and denominator
                    round alike."""
                    sa_ = srs_.ir_value()
                    sb_ = fx.Float32(0.0).ir_value()
                    for k in range_constexpr(4):
                        sa_ = _mrocdl.fdot2(
                            T.f32, pa_.shuffle(pa_, [2 * k, 2 * k + 1]).ir_value(), ones2, sa_
                        ).result
                        sb_ = _mrocdl.fdot2(
                            T.f32, pb_.shuffle(pb_, [2 * k, 2 * k + 1]).ir_value(), ones2, sb_
                        ).result
                    return fx.Float32(sa_) + fx.Float32(sb_)

                def rescale(mraw, mr, sr, sv):
                    """Move the reference to the new max plus ROFF and take the weights against it."""
                    _keep_branch()
                    o = _swap(mraw * scale2, True)
                    mn = mr.maximumf(o[0].maximumf(o[1]) + fx.Float32(roff))
                    al = (mr == fx.Float32(MINIT)).select(
                        fx.Float32(1.0), fmath.exp2(mr - mn, fastmath="afn")
                    )
                    pn = [fmath.exp2(fx.fma(sv[r], scale2, -mn), fastmath="afn") for r in range(16)]
                    return [mn, al, sr * al] + pn

                def keep(mr, sr, pv0):
                    return [mr, fx.Float32(1.0), sr] + pv0

                # Steps 0 .. nsteps - 1; the value waves' extra step (PV of the last) is matched by one barrier.
                for it, st in range(fx.Int32(0), nsteps, fx.Int32(1), init=init):
                    itv = fx.Int32(it)
                    bpos = pos0 + itv * BI
                    cur = itv % fx.Int32(NR)
                    par = itv & fx.Int32(1)

                    # One barrier a step: tile it is complete, P / alpha of step it - 2 are consumed, and every
                    # wave is done with tile it - 2, whose buffer this step's DMAs (of step it + DMAD) overwrite.
                    fx.barrier()
                    sa = Vec.filled(16, 0.0, Float32)
                    tb = cur * TILE8
                    kvs = [kread(tb, i) for i in range(QLA)]
                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                    sr = rowsum(fx.Float32(st[1]), Vec(st[2]), Vec(st[3]))
                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                    for i in range_constexpr(NQK):
                        sa = Vec(
                            rocdl.mfma_scale_f32_32x32x64_f8f6f4(
                                T.vec(16, T.f32), [kvs[i], qv[i], sa, 0, 0, 0, unit, 0, unit]
                            )
                        )
                        if i + QLA < NQK:
                            kvs.append(kread(tb, i + QLA))
                        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                    # Raw logits; the scale is applied by the max (exact: scale2 > 0) and folded into the exponent.
                    sv = [fx.Float32(sa[r]) for r in range(16)]
                    # Keys past the query's prefix weigh 0 at any logit scale: a uniform branch from the prefix's end.
                    if bpos + fx.Int32(BI) > et:
                        _keep_branch()
                        kb = bpos + 4 * hc
                        sv = [
                            (kb + fx.Int32(8 * (r // 4) + r % 4) < et).select(
                                sv[r], fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
                            )
                            for r in range(16)
                        ]
                    # The running sum stays a per-lane partial, reduced after the loop; the cross-lane max runs only
                    # when a ballot on the lane-local maxima finds a head that gained more than TAU.
                    mr = fx.Float32(st[0])
                    # Weights against the carried reference, sunk by the backend into the branch that keeps it; the
                    # threshold in raw-logit units keeps its multiply off the tree max's chain to the ballot.
                    pv0 = [fmath.exp2(fx.fma(sv[r], scale2, -mr), fastmath="afn") for r in range(16)]
                    mraw = _tree_max(sv)
                    thr = (mr + fx.Float32(tau)) * inv_s2
                    fires = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, mraw > thr)) != fx.Int64(0)
                    sres = _if_else(
                        fires,
                        functools.partial(rescale, mraw, mr, sr, sv),
                        functools.partial(keep, mr, sr, pv0),
                        [T.f32] * (3 + len(sv)),
                    )
                    mnew = fx.Float32(sres[0])
                    alpha = fx.Float32(sres[1])
                    srs = fx.Float32(sres[2])
                    pv = [fx.Float32(x) for x in sres[3:]]
                    fx.ptr_store(
                        Vec.from_elements([alpha], Float32),
                        fx.add_offset(abp, par * (NWT * 16) + uw * 32 + hl),
                    )
                    pa = Vec.from_elements(pv[0:4] + pv[8:12], Float32).to(Float16)
                    pb = Vec.from_elements(pv[4:8] + pv[12:16], Float32).to(Float16)
                    pbase = par * (NWT * PWORDS)
                    fx.ptr_store(pa.bitcast(Int32), fx.add_offset(pbp, pbase + pslot0))
                    fx.ptr_store(pb.bitcast(Int32), fx.add_offset(pbp, pbase + pslot1))
                    res = yield [mnew, srs, pa, pb]

                rfin = rowsum(fx.Float32(res[1]), Vec(res[2]), Vec(res[3]))
                fx.barrier()
                mrun = fx.Float32(res[0])  # lse = reference + log2(weights' sum), whatever the reference
                o = _swap(rfin, True)
                rrun = o[0] + o[1]
                nonempty = rrun > fx.Float32(0.0)
                # A row's only chunk writes the output: kv_scale joins before its one rounding to bf16.
                inv = nonempty.select(
                    (crow == fx.Int32(1)).select(vscale, fx.Float32(1.0)) / rrun, fx.Float32(0.0)
                )
                lsev = nonempty.select(
                    (mrun + fmath.log2(rrun.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38)))) * LN2,
                    fx.Float32(NEGBIG),
                )
                hq = uw * 32 + hl
                fx.ptr_store(Vec.from_elements([inv], Float32), fx.add_offset(ibp, hq))
                if (lane < fx.Int32(32)) & (fh0 + hq < fx.Int32(QL * HQ)):
                    if crow == fx.Int32(1):
                        fx.ptr_store(
                            Vec.from_elements(
                                [nonempty.select(lsev, fx.Float32(float("-inf")))],
                                Float32,
                            ),
                            fx.add_offset(lse_t, obase + hq),
                        )
                    else:
                        pl_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(pl_t))
                        _bstore(lsev.ir_value(), pl_rs, (slot * NHEAD + hq) * 4, PSTORE)
                fx.barrier()
            else:
                vw = uw - fx.Int32(NQW)

                def plain_body(pn0, ndv):
                    """A value wave that gathers nothing: PV(it - 1) over value tiles pn0 .. pn0 + ndv - 1."""
                    poffs = pv_offsets(pn0, ndv)
                    NA = NQT * ndv
                    init = [Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32) for _ in range(NA)]
                    for it, st in range(fx.Int32(0), nm1, fx.Int32(1), init=init):
                        acc = [Vec(st[n]) for n in range(NA)]
                        itv = fx.Int32(it)
                        prv = (itv + fx.Int32(NR - 1)) % fx.Int32(NR)
                        ppar = fx.Int32(1) - (itv & fx.Int32(1))
                        fx.barrier()
                        acc = pv_step(acc, poffs, prv * TILE8, ppar)
                        res = yield acc

                    acc = [Vec(res[n]) for n in range(NA)]
                    if nsteps > fx.Int32(0):
                        acc = pv_only(acc, poffs, nsteps - fx.Int32(1))
                    acc = pv_only(acc, poffs, nsteps)
                    fx.barrier()
                    store_out(acc, pn0, ndv)

                def gather_body(pn0, ndv):
                    """A gathering value wave: PV(it - 1) over value tiles pn0 .. pn0 + ndv - 1."""
                    poffs = pv_offsets(pn0, ndv)
                    NA = NQT * ndv
                    # Lane l fetches piece 2 p + l // 32 of key l % 32: one DMA fills piece pair p of the tile, this
                    # wave PPW pairs a step; step s's group issues at step s - DMAD.
                    hh = lane // 32
                    pp0 = (vw - fx.Int32(GV0)) * PPW
                    pairw = 2 * PIECE // 4  # LDS words of a piece pair

                    def dma(sidx, s):
                        """Group of step s (wave-uniform) from pool row sidx (past nsteps each lane reads the
                        chunk's last key: one row)."""
                        gb = fx.add_offset(kv_row(sidx), hh * 4 + pp0 * 8)
                        lb = (s % fx.Int32(NR)) * (TILE8 // 4) + pp0 * pairw
                        for i in range_constexpr(PPW):
                            _mrocdl.load_async_to_lds(
                                fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.add_offset(gb, 8 * i)),
                                fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.add_offset(vi, lb + pairw * i)),
                                16,
                                0,
                            )

                    slp = lds.sl.ptr
                    srb = (vw - fx.Int32(GV0)) * (NSR * 64)

                    def sdma(t):
                        """The table entries of step t (lane l: key l % 32) to this wave's slot ring, issued with the
                        group of step t - DMAD and read back one unit later."""
                        spos = pos0 + t * BI + kk
                        _mrocdl.load_async_to_lds(
                            fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.add_offset(bt_t, table_pos(spos))),
                            fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.add_offset(slp, srb + (t % fx.Int32(NSR)) * 64)),
                            4,
                            0,
                        )

                    # A unit is group g, then the slot DMA of step g + DMAD; VMW leaves DMAD - 1 units in flight.
                    # Not async marks: their intrinsics lack nocallback, so LLVM reserves AGPRs, halving the VGPRs.
                    VMW = (PPW + 1) * (DMAD - 1)
                    ss = [slot_at(pos0 + k * BI + kk) for k in range(DMAD)]
                    for k in range_constexpr(DMAD):
                        dma(ss[k], fx.Int32(k))
                        sdma(fx.Int32(k + DMAD))

                    init = [Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32) for _ in range(NA)]
                    for it, st in range(fx.Int32(0), nsteps, fx.Int32(1), init=init):
                        acc = [Vec(st[n]) for n in range(NA)]
                        itv = fx.Int32(it)
                        prv = (itv + fx.Int32(NR - 1)) % fx.Int32(NR)
                        ppar = fx.Int32(1) - (itv & fx.Int32(1))
                        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=VMW)
                        tn = itv + fx.Int32(DMAD)
                        fx.barrier()
                        # The slot entry landed with unit it - DMAD (retired by the wait), and only the slot DMA of
                        # step tn + NSR rewrites it: reading it after the barrier keeps the barrier off its wait.
                        sidx = fx.Int32(
                            fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(slp, srb + (tn % fx.Int32(NSR)) * 64 + lane))
                        )
                        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                        dma(sidx, tn)
                        sdma(tn + fx.Int32(DMAD))
                        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                        acc = pv_step(acc, poffs, prv * TILE8, ppar)
                        res = yield acc

                    acc = [Vec(res[n]) for n in range(NA)]
                    acc = pv_only(acc, poffs, nsteps)
                    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)  # every DMA lands before the kernel's end
                    fx.barrier()
                    store_out(acc, pn0, ndv)

                t0 = 0
                for k in range_constexpr(NWT - NQW):
                    if vw == fx.Int32(k):
                        if const_expr(GV0 <= k <= GV1):
                            gather_body(fx.Int32(t0), vtiles[k])
                        else:
                            plain_body(fx.Int32(t0), vtiles[k])
                    t0 += vtiles[k]

            def fold_merge(row, cbase, crow, sp, slot, obase, fh0, vscale):
                """The row's chunks meet on its arrival word (tag | hand-offs | arrivals): each merges its slice once
                all have published, or after a bounded wait hands it to the chunk completing the arrivals. A unit
                merges the same way whoever merges it, so the output bits do not depend on who did."""
                zi = fx.Int32(0).ir_value()
                fl_n = (ABOFF + NSLOT * 2) * 4
                fl_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fl_t, num_records_bytes=fl_n))
                po_n = NSLOT * NHEAD * DV * 2
                po_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(po_t, num_records_bytes=po_n))
                pl_n = NSLOT * NHEAD * 4
                pl_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(pl_t, num_records_bytes=pl_n))
                o_n = (rows // RPQ) * QL * HQ * DV * 2
                o_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(out_t, num_records_bytes=o_n))
                ls_n = (rows // RPQ) * QL * HQ * 4
                ls_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(lse_t, num_records_bytes=ls_n))
                # a look at the row's arrival word goes out before the wait on the partial stores, not after it
                w0 = Vec(
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                        T.i32x2, fl_rs, fx.Int32(row * (FLP * 4)).ir_value(), zi, aux=SC1
                    )
                )
                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)  # every wave's partial stores land before the arrival says so
                fx.barrier()
                # the launch's tag: dispatch id * H1 + queue address * H2, 40 bits of it, one forced set
                did = _llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.dispatch.id", [], [], [])
                qptr = _llvm.call_intrinsic(_llvm.PointerType.get(4), "llvm.amdgcn.queue.ptr", [], [], [])
                qpi = _llvm.ptrtoint(T.i64, qptr)
                tag64 = _arith.addi(
                    _arith.muli(did, _arith.constant(T.i64, TAG_H1)),
                    _arith.muli(qpi, _arith.constant(T.i64, TAG_H2)),
                )
                tag_lo = (_uni(fx.Int32(_arith.trunci(T.i32, tag64))) & fx.Int32(TAGM)) | fx.Int32(
                    1 << (2 * CNTB)
                )
                tag_hi = _uni(fx.Int32(_arith.trunci(T.i32, _arith.shrui(tag64, _arith.constant(T.i64, 32)))))
                slp = lds.sl.ptr

                def split64(x):
                    lo_ = _uni(fx.Int32(_arith.trunci(T.i32, x)))
                    hi_ = _uni(fx.Int32(_arith.trunci(T.i32, _arith.shrui(x, _arith.constant(T.i64, 32)))))
                    return lo_, hi_

                def pack(lo_, hi_):
                    return (
                        Vec.from_elements([fx.Int32(lo_), fx.Int32(hi_)], Int32).bitcast(Int64)[0].ir_value()
                    )

                def ours(lo_, hi_):
                    return ((fx.Int32(lo_) & fx.Int32(TAGM)) == tag_lo) & (fx.Int32(hi_) == tag_hi)

                if uw == fx.Int32(POLLW):
                    # lane 0 alone performs the atomics: every other lane's offset is out of range
                    aoff = (lane == fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(row * (FLP * 4)), fx.Int32(fl_n))

                    def atom(name, v):
                        r_ = _llvm.call_intrinsic(
                            T.i64,
                            name,
                            [_arith.constant(T.i64, v), fl_rs, aoff.ir_value(), zi, zi],
                            [],
                            [],
                        )
                        return split64(r_)

                    def cas(n_lo, n_hi, c_lo, c_hi):
                        r_ = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_atomic_cmpswap(
                            T.i64, pack(n_lo, n_hi), pack(c_lo, c_hi), fl_rs, aoff.ir_value(), zi
                        )
                        r_lo, r_hi = split64(r_)
                        return (r_lo == fx.Int32(c_lo)) & (r_hi == fx.Int32(c_hi)), r_lo, r_hi

                    w_lo = _uni(fx.Int32(w0[0]))
                    w_hi = _uni(fx.Int32(w0[1]))
                    # arrive: add one to a word of this launch, else claim it; yields the word before this arrival
                    aop = _scf.WhileOp([T.i32, T.i32, T.i32], [zi, w_lo.ir_value(), w_hi.ir_value()])
                    abb = aop.before.blocks.append(T.i32, T.i32, T.i32)
                    with _ir.InsertionPoint(abb):
                        _scf.ConditionOp(
                            _arith.cmpi(_arith.CmpIPredicate.eq, abb.arguments[0], zi), list(abb.arguments)
                        )
                    aab = aop.after.blocks.append(T.i32, T.i32, T.i32)
                    with _ir.InsertionPoint(aab):
                        c_lo = fx.Int32(aab.arguments[1])
                        c_hi = fx.Int32(aab.arguments[2])

                        def do_add():
                            o_lo, o_hi = atom("llvm.amdgcn.raw.ptr.buffer.atomic.add.i64", 1)
                            return [fx.Int32(1), o_lo, o_hi]

                        def do_claim():
                            won, r_lo, r_hi = cas(tag_lo | fx.Int32(1), tag_hi, c_lo, c_hi)
                            return [
                                won.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)),
                                won.select(tag_lo, r_lo),
                                won.select(tag_hi, r_hi),
                            ]

                        _scf.YieldOp(_if_else(ours(c_lo, c_hi), do_add, do_claim, [T.i32, T.i32, T.i32]))
                    arrived = (fx.Int32(aop.results[1]) & fx.Int32(CNTM)) + fx.Int32(1)
                    complete = arrived >= crow

                    def waiter():
                        """Wait for the arrivals to complete, bounded: on timeout hand this slice to the chunk
                        completing them."""
                        t0 = _llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], [])
                        wop = _scf.WhileOp([T.i32], [zi])
                        wbb = wop.before.blocks.append(T.i32)
                        with _ir.InsertionPoint(wbb):
                            _scf.ConditionOp(
                                _arith.cmpi(_arith.CmpIPredicate.eq, wbb.arguments[0], zi), [wbb.arguments[0]]
                            )
                        wab = wop.after.blocks.append(T.i32)
                        with _ir.InsertionPoint(wab):
                            c_lo, c_hi = atom("llvm.amdgcn.raw.ptr.buffer.atomic.or.i64", 0)
                            done = (~ours(c_lo, c_hi)) | ((c_lo & fx.Int32(CNTM)) >= crow)
                            now = _llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], [])
                            late = fx.Int32(
                                _arith.extui(
                                    T.i32,
                                    _arith.cmpi(
                                        _arith.CmpIPredicate.sgt,
                                        _arith.subi(now, t0),
                                        _arith.constant(T.i64, WAIT_TICKS),
                                    ),
                                )
                            )
                            give = (~done) & (late != fx.Int32(0))

                            def abandon():
                                _bstore(
                                    Vec.from_elements([tag_lo, tag_hi], Int32),
                                    fl_rs,
                                    (lane == fx.Int32(0)).select(
                                        fx.Int32(ABOFF * 4) + slot * 8, fx.Int32(fl_n)
                                    ),
                                    SC1,
                                )
                                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
                                won, _, _ = cas(c_lo + fx.Int32(1 << CNTB), c_hi, c_lo, c_hi)
                                return [won.select(fx.Int32(ROLE_GAVE), fx.Int32(0))]

                            def keep():
                                return [done.select(fx.Int32(ROLE_OWN), fx.Int32(0))]

                            _scf.YieldOp(_if_else(give, abandon, keep, [T.i32]))
                        return [wop.results[0]]

                    def completer():
                        """Every hand-off counts in the word before the completing add lands (a later compare-swap
                        fails), so with none the scan is skipped."""
                        hof = (fx.Int32(aop.results[1]) >> fx.Int32(CNTB)) & fx.Int32(CNTM)
                        return [(hof != fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(ROLE_SCAN), fx.Int32(ROLE_LAST))]

                    role = fx.Int32(_if_else(complete, completer, waiter, [T.i32])[0])
                    fx.ptr_store(Vec.from_elements([role], Int32), fx.add_offset(slp, 0))
                fx.barrier()
                role = _uni(fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(slp, 0))))

                negb = fx.Float32(NEGBIG)
                zerof = fx.Float32(0.0)

                pbm = lds.pb.ptr

                def write_unit(mrun, tot, acc, hs, ccs, uok):
                    """Normalize a merged unit to bf16 and store it; a head's first unit stores its LSE."""
                    live = mrun > fx.Float32(-1.0e29)
                    mul = live.select(vscale / tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38)), zerof)
                    ow = Vec(acc * Vec.from_elements([mul] * 8, Float32)).to(BFloat16).bitcast(Int32)
                    _bstore(ow, o_rs, uok.select(((obase + hs) * DV + ccs * 8) * 2, fx.Int32(o_n)), SC1)
                    lsef = mrun + fmath.log2(tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38))) * LN2
                    lsev_ = live.select(lsef, fx.Float32(float("-inf")))
                    hl0 = uok & (ccs == fx.Int32(0))
                    _bstore(lsev_.ir_value(), ls_rs, hl0.select((obase + hs) * 4, fx.Int32(ls_n)), SC1)

                def merge_two(s):
                    """Units [s NU / crow, (s + 1) NU / crow) of a row of at most CB chunks: a wave's units span at
                    most two heads, whose (head, chunk) weights its lanes compute once, one each, through the wave's
                    LDS block; each unit sums its partials in chunk order."""
                    ulo = (s * NU) // crow
                    uhi = ((s + fx.Int32(1)) * NU) // crow
                    wbk = uw * fx.Int32(MWB)
                    for ub in range(ulo, uhi, fx.Int32(THREADS)):
                        wb = fx.Int32(ub) + uw * fx.Int32(64)
                        if wb < uhi:
                            _keep_branch()
                            u = wb + lane
                            hs = u // (DV // 8)
                            uok = (u < uhi) & (fh0 + hs < fx.Int32(QL * HQ))
                            ccs = u % (DV // 8)
                            hbase = wb // (DV // 8)
                            hl1 = lane // MCH
                            c1 = lane % MCH
                            h1 = hbase + hl1
                            ok1 = (c1 < crow) & (h1 < fx.Int32(NHEAD)) & (fh0 + h1 < fx.Int32(QL * HQ))
                            lraw = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                                T.f32,
                                pl_rs,
                                ok1.select(((cbase + c1) * NHEAD + h1) * 4, fx.Int32(pl_n)).ir_value(),
                                zi,
                                aux=SC1,
                            )
                            ovs = []
                            for k in range_constexpr(CB):
                                ok = (fx.Int32(k) < crow) & uok
                                pr = (cbase + fx.Int32(k)) * NHEAD + hs
                                ovs.append(
                                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                                        T.i32x4,
                                        po_rs,
                                        ok.select((pr * DV + ccs * 8) * 2, fx.Int32(po_n)).ir_value(),
                                        zi,
                                        aux=SC1,
                                    )
                                )
                            l1 = ok1.select(fx.Float32(lraw), negb)
                            fx.ptr_store(
                                Vec.from_elements([l1], Float32).bitcast(Int32),
                                fx.add_offset(pbm, wbk + lane),
                            )
                            mn1 = negb
                            for i in range_constexpr(CB4):
                                lv = Vec(
                                    fx.ptr_load(
                                        fx.add_offset(pbm, wbk + hl1 * MCH + fx.Int32(4 * i)), T.i32x4
                                    )
                                )
                                lv = lv.bitcast(Float32)
                                for e in range_constexpr(4):
                                    mn1 = mn1.maximumf(fx.Float32(lv[e]))
                            w1 = ok1.select(fmath.exp2((l1 - mn1) * LOG2E), zerof)
                            fx.ptr_store(
                                Vec.from_elements([w1], Float32).bitcast(Int32),
                                fx.add_offset(pbm, wbk + 2 * MCH + lane),
                            )
                            fx.ptr_store(
                                Vec.from_elements([mn1], Float32).bitcast(Int32),
                                fx.add_offset(pbm, wbk + 4 * MCH + hl1),
                            )
                            hl = hs - hbase
                            mrun = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(pbm, wbk + 4 * MCH + hl))).bitcast(
                                Float32
                            )
                            ws = []
                            for i in range_constexpr(CB4):
                                wo = wbk + 2 * MCH + hl * MCH + fx.Int32(4 * i)
                                wv = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(pbm, wo), T.i32x4)).bitcast(Float32)
                                for e in range_constexpr(4):
                                    ws.append(fx.Float32(wv[e]))
                            tot = zerof
                            acc = Vec.filled(8, 0.0, Float32)
                            for k in range_constexpr(CB):
                                tot = tot + ws[k]
                                acc = Vec(
                                    fx.fma(
                                        Vec(ovs[k]).bitcast(Float16).to(Float32),
                                        Vec.from_elements([ws[k]] * 8, Float32),
                                        acc,
                                    )
                                )
                            write_unit(mrun, tot, acc, hs, ccs, uok)

                def merge_slice(s):
                    """A slice of a row of at most CB chunks by merge_two, else by merge_online: the choice is the
                    row's, so a unit merges the same way whoever merges it."""
                    if crow <= fx.Int32(CB):
                        _keep_branch()
                        merge_two(s)
                    if crow > fx.Int32(CB):
                        _keep_branch()
                        merge_online(s)

                def merge_online(s):
                    """Units [s NU / crow, (s + 1) NU / crow) of the row: lane-parallel, each over the row's chunks in
                    order with an online max."""
                    ulo = (s * NU) // crow
                    uhi = ((s + fx.Int32(1)) * NU) // crow
                    for ub in range(ulo, uhi, fx.Int32(THREADS)):
                        u = fx.Int32(ub) + tid
                        hs = u // (DV // 8)
                        uok = (u < uhi) & (fh0 + hs < fx.Int32(QL * HQ))
                        ccs = u % (DV // 8)
                        init = [negb, zerof, Vec.filled(8, 0.0, Float32)]
                        for c0, st in range(fx.Int32(0), crow, fx.Int32(CB), init=init):
                            mrun = fx.Float32(st[0])
                            tot = fx.Float32(st[1])
                            acc = Vec(st[2])
                            oks = []
                            lvs = []
                            ovs = []
                            for k in range_constexpr(CB):
                                c = fx.Int32(c0) + fx.Int32(k)
                                ok = (c < crow) & uok
                                pr = (cbase + c) * NHEAD + hs
                                oks.append(ok)
                                lvs.append(
                                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                                        T.f32,
                                        pl_rs,
                                        ok.select(pr * 4, fx.Int32(pl_n)).ir_value(),
                                        zi,
                                        aux=SC1,
                                    )
                                )
                                ovs.append(
                                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                                        T.i32x4,
                                        po_rs,
                                        ok.select((pr * DV + ccs * 8) * 2, fx.Int32(po_n)).ir_value(),
                                        zi,
                                        aux=SC1,
                                    )
                                )
                            lvs = [oks[k].select(fx.Float32(lvs[k]), negb) for k in range(CB)]
                            mn = mrun
                            for k in range_constexpr(CB):
                                mn = mn.maximumf(lvs[k])
                            a0 = fmath.exp2((mrun - mn) * LOG2E)
                            tot = tot * a0
                            acc = Vec(acc * Vec.from_elements([a0] * 8, Float32))
                            for k in range_constexpr(CB):
                                w = oks[k].select(fmath.exp2((lvs[k] - mn) * LOG2E), zerof)
                                tot = tot + w
                                acc = Vec(
                                    fx.fma(
                                        Vec(ovs[k]).bitcast(Float16).to(Float32),
                                        Vec.from_elements([w] * 8, Float32),
                                        acc,
                                    )
                                )
                            res = yield [mn, tot, acc]
                        write_unit(fx.Float32(res[0]), fx.Float32(res[1]), Vec(res[2]), hs, ccs, uok)

                if role != fx.Int32(ROLE_GAVE):
                    _keep_branch()
                    merge_slice(sp)
                if role == fx.Int32(ROLE_SCAN):
                    _keep_branch()
                    # the slices handed off: their hand-off words carry this launch's tag
                    for c0 in range(fx.Int32(0), crow, fx.Int32(64)):
                        c = fx.Int32(c0) + lane
                        hw = Vec(
                            rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                                T.i32x2,
                                fl_rs,
                                (c < crow)
                                .select(fx.Int32(ABOFF * 4) + (cbase + c) * 8, fx.Int32(fl_n))
                                .ir_value(),
                                zi,
                                aux=SC1,
                            )
                        )
                        hit = (fx.Int32(hw[0]) == tag_lo) & (fx.Int32(hw[1]) == tag_hi) & (c < crow)
                        hm = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, hit))
                        if hm != fx.Int64(0):
                            _keep_branch()
                            for j in range(fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(64), fx.Int32(1)):
                                bit = (hm >> fx.Int64(fx.Int32(j))) & fx.Int64(1)
                                if bit != fx.Int64(0):
                                    _keep_branch()
                                    merge_slice(fx.Int32(c0) + fx.Int32(j))
                if (role == fx.Int32(ROLE_SCAN)) | (role == fx.Int32(ROLE_LAST)):
                    _keep_branch()
                    if uw == fx.Int32(0):
                        # the word goes back to zero: the next launch claims it with no stale arrivals
                        aoff0 = (lane == fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(row * (FLP * 4)), fx.Int32(fl_n))
                        _bstore(Vec.from_elements([fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0)], Int32), fl_rs, aoff0, SC1)

            if const_expr(FOLD):
                if crow != fx.Int32(1):  # a row's only chunk stored the output, and the combine skips the row
                    fold_merge(row, cbase, crow, sp, slot, obase, fh0, vscale)

        # CTAs past the last chunk have nothing to do.
        if b < ocnum:
            seg_body()

    def _pair(x, step):
        """The Float32 x of lane and of lane ^ step (8, 16 or 32), in some order: DPP row_ror:8, else a permlane swap."""
        if step == 8:
            return [x, _dpp(fx.Float32(x).bitcast(Int32), ROWROR8).bitcast(Float32)]
        return _swap(x, step == 32)

    def _mix(m, t, acc, step):
        """Merge the (max, sum, unnormalized acc) of lane and lane ^ step: the same bits in both."""
        mo = _pair(m, step)
        mn = mo[0].maximumf(mo[1])
        e = [fmath.exp2((x - mn) * LOG2E) for x in mo]
        to = _pair(t, step)
        ao = [_pair(fx.Float32(acc[i]), step) for i in range(CPT)]
        acc = Vec.from_elements([ao[i][0] * e[0] + ao[i][1] * e[1] for i in range(CPT)], Float32)
        return mn, to[0] * e[0] + to[1] * e[1], acc

    @flyc.kernel
    def comb_kernel(po_t, pl_t, mt_t, out_t, lse_t, ks_t):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        lane = tid % 64
        sl = tid // 64
        rh = fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.x)
        row = rh // NHEAD
        head = rh - row * NHEAD
        mt = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(mt_t, row * 2), T.i32x2))
        cb = fx.Int32(mt[0])
        nl = fx.Int32(mt[1])
        # A row of one chunk was written by its chunk.
        rreq = row // RPQ
        fh = (row - rreq * RPQ) * NHEAD + head
        ohead = rreq * (QL * HQ) + fh
        if (nl != fx.Int32(1)) & (fh < fx.Int32(QL * HQ)):  # padding heads are not written
            negb = fx.Float32(NEGBIG)
            zerof = fx.Float32(0.0)
            # Wave sl takes columns sl DV / CSL ..; its lane group cg runs an online merge over chunks cg, cg + CSL, ..
            # and the groups meet in a fixed tree, so the merge is the same bits on every run.
            cg = lane // (64 // CSL)
            col = sl * (DV // CSL) + (lane % (64 // CSL)) * CPT
            mrun = negb
            tot = zerof
            acc = Vec.filled(CPT, 0.0, Float32)
            for c0 in range(fx.Int32(0), nl, fx.Int32(CSL * CUNR)):
                oks = []
                lvs = []
                ovs = []
                for k in range_constexpr(CUNR):
                    c = fx.Int32(c0) + fx.Int32(CSL * k) + cg
                    oks.append(c < nl)
                    off = (cb + (c < nl).select(c, fx.Int32(0))) * NHEAD + head
                    lvs.append(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(pl_t, off)))
                    ovs.append(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(po_t, off * DV + col), T.f16x8))
                lvs = [oks[k].select(fx.Float32(lvs[k]), negb) for k in range(CUNR)]
                mn = mrun
                for k in range_constexpr(CUNR):
                    mn = mn.maximumf(lvs[k])
                a0 = fmath.exp2((mrun - mn) * LOG2E)
                tot = tot * a0
                acc = Vec(acc * Vec.from_elements([a0] * CPT, Float32))
                for k in range_constexpr(CUNR):
                    w = oks[k].select(fmath.exp2((lvs[k] - mn) * LOG2E), zerof)
                    tot = tot + w
                    acc = Vec(
                        fx.fma(
                            Vec(ovs[k]).to(Float32),
                            Vec.from_elements([w] * CPT, Float32),
                            acc,
                        )
                    )
                mrun = mn
            for k in range_constexpr(CSL.bit_length() - 1):
                mrun, tot, acc = _mix(mrun, tot, acc, (64 // CSL) << k)
            live = mrun > fx.Float32(-1.0e29)
            lsef = mrun + fmath.log2(tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38))) * LN2
            vscale = fx.Float32(fx.ptr_load(ks_t))
            mul = live.select(vscale / tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38)), zerof)
            if cg == fx.Int32(0):
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec(acc * Vec.from_elements([mul] * CPT, Float32)).to(BFloat16),
                    fx.add_offset(out_t, ohead * DV + col),
                )
            if tid == fx.Int32(0):
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec.from_elements([live.select(lsef, fx.Float32(float("-inf")))], Float32),
                    fx.add_offset(lse_t, ohead),
                )

    @flyc.jit
    def launch_all(
        q_t, kv_t, bt_t, ln_t, gp_t, mt_t, po_t, pl_t, out_t, lse_t, qs_t, ks_t, fl_t, stream: fx.Stream
    ):
        part_kernel(ks_t, qs_t, ln_t, gp_t, q_t, bt_t, kv_t, fl_t, po_t, pl_t, out_t, lse_t, mt_t).launch(
            grid=(nblk, 1, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )
        if const_expr(not FOLD):
            comb_kernel(po_t, pl_t, mt_t, out_t, lse_t, ks_t).launch(
                grid=(rows * NHEAD, 1, 1), block=(64 * CSL, 1, 1), stream=stream
            )

    launch_all.compile_hints = {
        **launch_all.compile_hints,
        "llvm_options": {"amdgpu-kernarg-preload-count": KAPRE},
    }

    def launch(q, kv_buffer, kv_indices, kv_indptr, g_kv_indptr, q_scale, kv_scale, o, lse):
        po = torch.empty((NSLOT * NHEAD * DV,), dtype=torch.float16, device=q.device)
        pl = torch.empty((NSLOT * NHEAD,), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
        mt = torch.empty((rows * 2,), dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
        # arrival and hand-off words, not cleared: a word counts only with this launch's tag, and is zeroed after use
        fl = torch.empty((ABOFF + NSLOT * 2,), dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
        # Bare pointers: each argument is one 64-bit word, so the preloaded words carry whole pointers.
        launch_all(
            from_c_void_p(Int32, q.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, kv_buffer.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, kv_indices.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, kv_indptr.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, g_kv_indptr.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, mt.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(Float16, po.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(Float32, pl.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(BFloat16, o.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            from_c_void_p(Float32, lse.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Float32, q_scale.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Float32, kv_scale.data_ptr(), assumed_align=4),
            from_c_void_p(Int32, fl.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16),
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream()),
        )

    return launch


def run(*, q, kv_buffer, kv_indptr, kv_indices, g_kv_indptr, q_scale, kv_scale, sm_scale, cp_rank, o, lse):
    """Write the round-robin MLA verify of this request batch into o and lse."""
    # one build per power of two of kv_indices' entries, which bounds the split search and each row's length: a table
    # length first seen while serving compiles only past every one seen before
    width = 1 << max(kv_indices.numel() - 1, 1).bit_length()
    fn = _build(float(sm_scale), q.shape[0] * RPQ, width, q.device.index, int(cp_rank), kv_indices.numel())
    fn(q, kv_buffer, kv_indices, kv_indptr, g_kv_indptr, q_scale, kv_scale, o, lse)
